name: SimopsConflictPlanner
tagline: Plan simultaneous operations safely – interaction matrix, conflict detection, required controls and OIM approval in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete SIMOPS app for offshore platforms, well sites and plants: a daily area-by-hour plan with drag-to-reschedule, automatic detection of prohibited and controlled interactions (same area or facility-wide), required controls, a configurable interaction matrix, an activity register and an approval queue that blocks unsafe plans. Works at once with demo data; connects to Dataverse, SharePoint, collections or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Low-code interaction rules (Prohibited / Controlled with controls)
Drag, keyboard and one-click reschedule to the next clear window
Record required controls on a conflict
Approval with pre-checks, permit and control confirmation
Start rules: permit, early-start window, active clashes
Live SIMOPS check in the form
Bulk actions, grouping, CSV export, undo
controlType: standard (data-set) + standard field control SimopsConflictPlannerPortal for Power Pages
